MESSAGE:
Dear Acme Cloud Services team,

Thank you for your email regarding renewal of our services agreement, currently in term from 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026 at an annual fee of Rs 24,00,000 (Rs 2,00,000 per month).

Per Clause 8.1, renewal requires mutual written agreement, and Clause 8.2 caps renewal price increases at 7% unless both parties agree otherwise in writing. The proposed 12% increase (to Rs 2,24,000 per month) exceeds this cap and is not acceptable as presented.

Separately, under Clause 4.1 the monthly uptime SLA target is 99.9%, with a 5% service credit per month of shortfall under Clause 4.2. Our records show shortfalls in May 2026 (99.42%) and July 2026 (99.61%), resulting in service credits owed of Rs 20,000. We request these credits be applied before any renewal terms are finalized.

Given current market conditions, we have received competitive offers at lower monthly rates with comparable or better SLA commitments. We value our relationship with Acme and would like to explore a renewal within the 7% cap permitted under Clause 8.2, alongside prompt application of the Rs 20,000 service credit.

We propose a revised monthly fee of Rs 2,14,000 (7% increase) for a further 12-month term, subject to final confirmation. Please let us know if this is agreeable, or share your thoughts so we can proceed to a mutually acceptable written agreement.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards,
Nimbus Retail Procurement
